services.desc: A wide selection of hardshell kayaks, inflatable kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, and kayaking accessories. services.desc: Explore our interactive boat in more detail. You'll find there's room for it all. Not all items pictured are included in an "à la carte" oar rig rental. Included here for reference. *** Through years of experience and experimentation, we have come up with a very simple, user-friendly setup. The oar boats come fully rigged, are easy to use, and have an ideal amount of gear hauling capacity. Our oar boat rentals are a complete package. blurb: Moenkopi Riverworks provides full service or à la carte rentals for private Grand Canyon river trips. They offer door-to-door outfitting to simplify the planning process. Their team supports guests every step of the way to reduce stress and enhance enjoyment on the river.
